intro: The Barrow Key is one of three druidic keys hidden within the Talon Den atop Stonetalon Peak. It is kept locked inside a barrow cache to guard the ancient treasures sealed within the den's hoard.

p: Within the subterranean barrows of the Talon Den, night elf druids established elaborate wards to protect their relics from interlopers. The Barrow Key is one piece of this multi-layered lock, concealed inside a specialized cache hidden among the subterranean passages. Accessing it requires the Gatekeeper's Key, ensuring that only those with knowledge of the druids' defensive network can ever hope to claim it.
